content: E1: Whole linked chunks are treated as unit text; locator/requires_span are unused, empty content still increments processed and returns complete. Enforce bounded source-unit reads and span/budget protection through the prose orchestrator.

E2: A numbered continuation searches only by table number, merging chapter 7 Table 1 continuation into chapter 4 Table 1 as confirmed. Bind all grouping passes to source chapter/scope; same-number multiple targets require disambiguation.

E3: Every leading row with a nonnumeric first cell becomes header. A valid pH/total-mercury table returns no items yet complete via enumerate_table. Detect data without requiring sequence numbers and reject unreadable fragments.

E4: fragment_index is the global row index, so the 13-row two-fragment GB8978 output points to nonexistent fragments 2-12. Preserve actual physical fragment and row provenance through grid parsing; verify each citation by independently reading its source.

E5: There is no final active/source check; the single-page path performs only one active lookup and can return complete after replacement. source_snapshot_id is incorrectly set to the catalog snapshot. Bind workspace and separate source fingerprint, verify the full read window, and validate every return.

E6: Missing citation_verified is accepted as complete because only literal False is rejected; require explicit True and a valid citation identity/locator. Model validation also marks missing quotes verified.

E7: No enumeration command or submitted run generator is shipped, and prose helpers have no supported orchestration path that propagates span/model failures into coverage. Deliver replayable three-kind entry points plus the requested real small-range paragraph-item extraction.
